verifications.claim: X (formerly Twitter) is currently experiencing intermittent issues for many users as of March 26, 2026, according to Downdetector.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'User reports indicate problems with X (Twitter) since 4:29 PM EDT'; R5: 'users in some regions have reported intermittent issues... as of Thursday, March 26, 2026... Downdetector.com... showed relatively low levels of reported problems in the last 24 hours, with spikes limited to specific times'
verifications.reasoning: Downdetector (R1) shows recent reports starting afternoon of March 26 but headlines 'no current problems'; R5 (citing Downdetector) confirms intermittent issues on March 26 but not widespread or major.

verifications.claim: Reports of problems loading feeds and accessing the app on X (formerly Twitter), according to Downdetector.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Most reported problems 73% App ... 7% Feed / Timeline'; R2: '42% App 30% Feed / Timeline'; R3: '28% App ... Feed / Timeline'
verifications.reasoning: Downdetector sources directly list high percentages of reports for App and Feed/Timeline issues.

verifications.claim: X (formerly Twitter) is not experiencing a complete global blackout.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1-R3: 'User reports show no current problems with X (Twitter)'; R5: 'is not experiencing a widespread outage'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state no current problems or no widespread outage, supporting absence of complete global blackout.

verifications.claim: Thousands of users have reported issues with the app, timeline, and server connections on X (formerly Twitter).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '13% Server Connection ... 73% App ... 7% Feed / Timeline'; R5: 'affected thousands of users worldwide... primarily involving the website and app'; R6: 'more than 25,000 complaints'
verifications.reasoning: Sources report thousands of users and specific issues matching app, timeline (Feed), and server connections.

verifications.claim: Users are experiencing difficulties with the X app, website, and timeline refreshing, according to Downdetector.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '73% App ... 7% Feed / Timeline ... Website'; R2: '42% App ... 30% Feed / Timeline ... 19% Website'; R3: '28% App ... 17% Website'
verifications.reasoning: Downdetector directly reports percentages for App, Website, and Feed/Timeline (timeline refreshing) problems.

verifications.claim: Problems on X appear widespread, notes Newsweek.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Issues were widespread, with users in the United States, India, South America and parts of Europe among those reporting problems'
verifications.reasoning: Newsweek explicitly describes issues as widespread across multiple regions.

verifications.claim: Reports of problems on X from the United States, India, and Europe, notes Newsweek.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'users in the United States, India... and parts of Europe among those reporting problems'
verifications.reasoning: Newsweek directly lists reports from US, India, and parts of Europe.

verifications.claim: X issues have been intermittent over the past few days, according to IBT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'users... have reported intermittent issues with loading feeds, logging in and refreshing timelines over the past week... spikes limited to specific times'
verifications.reasoning: IBT (R5) explicitly states intermittent issues over the past week, aligning with 'past few days'.

verifications.claim: Notable spike in reports on X on March 26, 2026, according to IBT.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R5: 'relatively low levels of reported problems in the last 24 hours, with spikes limited to specific times rather than a sustained global disruption'
verifications.reasoning: IBT mentions spikes in the last 24 hours (March 26) but describes them as low levels, not explicitly 'notable'; earlier spikes on March 18/23 were larger.
